name: BuyWhere
description: Search 11M+ products across SG, SEA, and US. Agent-native catalog for AI shopping agents.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the BuyWhere product catalog — 300M+ products across 15+ countries. ALWAYS pass deliver_to (the buyer's ISO country code, e.g. "SG", "US") so results are scoped to products deliverable to that market; searches without deliver_to scan every country and can be slow or time out. Use compact=true for agent-optimized responses with structured_specs, comparison_attributes, and normalized_price_usd fields.

domain.description: Filter by merchant platform (e.g. lazada, shopee, amazon)

region.description: Filter by region (sea, us, eu, au)

deliver_to.description: Buyer's ISO country code (e.g. "SG", "US", "MY", "TH", "VN"). ALWAYS pass this — it scopes the search to products deliverable to that market, makes queries fast, and prevents timeouts. Takes precedence over country_code/country.

country_code.description: Filter by ISO country code. Also infers default currency for price filters (SG→SGD, US→USD, VN→VND, TH→THB, MY→MYR).

min_price.description: Minimum price (in currency inferred from country_code, or SGD by default)

max_price.description: Maximum price (in currency inferred from country_code, or SGD by default)

compact.description: Return agent-optimized compact shape: structured_specs, comparison_attributes, normalized_price_usd. Reduces response size ~40%. Recommended for agent tool-use.

category.description: Filter by product category name (e.g. "Laptops", "Smartphones", "Televisions"). Use to exclude accessories and get actual products.

mode.description: Search mode: keyword=FTS only, semantic=vector only, hybrid=RRF blend of FTS+vector (default). Falls back to keyword if vector DB or GEMINI_API_KEY unavailable.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get a specific product by its ID, including full details and current price.

tools.name: compare_products
tools.description: Compare multiple products side-by-side. Returns price, brand, rating, and category for each.

ids.description: Array of product IDs to compare (2-10)

tools.name: get_deals
tools.description: Get discounted products sorted by discount percentage. Returns products with original price and discount percentage. Supports currency, region (sea, us, eu, au) and country (SG, US, VN, MY, ...) filters.

currency.description: Filter by currency code (SGD, USD, MYR, VND, THB). Defaults to SGD.

region.description: Filter by region (sea, us, eu, au)

deliver_to.description: Buyer's ISO country code (e.g. "SG", "US", "MY", "TH", "VN"). ALWAYS pass this — it scopes the search to products deliverable to that market, makes queries fast, and prevents timeouts. Takes precedence over country_code/country.

country_code.description: Filter by ISO country code. Alias: country.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List top-level product categories available in the BuyWhere catalog.

country_code.description: Filter by ISO country code. Defaults to SG.

region.description: Alias for country_code/market (us→US, sg→SG, my→MY, gb→GB, in→IN, au→AU).

tools.name: find_best_price
tools.description: Use this whenever a user asks about prices, wants to find the cheapest option, or asks "what's the best price for X" or "where can I buy X for the lowest price". This finds the best current price across all merchants.

product_name.description: Product name to find best price for (e.g., "iphone 15 pro 256gb", "samsung galaxy s24")

deliver_to.description: Buyer's ISO country code (e.g. "SG", "US", "MY", "TH", "VN"). ALWAYS pass this — it scopes the search to products deliverable to that market, makes queries fast, and prevents timeouts. Takes precedence over country_code/country.

country_code.description: Country to search in (defaults to SG). Alias: country.

region.description: Region filter - use "us" for United States or "sea" for Southeast Asia

tools.name: find_similar
tools.description: Find products similar to a given product using vector similarity. Returns up to 10 nearest neighbours by semantic meaning (title+description embedding). Useful for "more like this" recommendations.

limit.description: Number of similar products to return (1-10, default 10)

tools.name: ingest_products
tools.description: Ingest (upsert) a batch of products into the BuyWhere catalog. Use this to add or update product listings from any merchant/source. Requires a valid API key with ingest permissions. Accepts up to 1000 products per call with source, SKU, title, price, URL, and optional metadata.

products.description: Array of product objects to ingest (max 1000)

url.description: Product URL on the merchant site

is_active.description: Whether the product is active (default: true)

is_available.description: Whether the product is in stock
